theorems.name: Submission.p04_prism_a8325b9888_equivariant_components
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (u v : G → G), (∀ (h : H) (g : G), u ((h : G) * g) = (h : G) * u g) → (∀ (h : H) (g : G), v ((h : G) * g) = (h : G) * v g) → let P : ∀ n : ℕ, (Fin (n + 1) → G) → MonoidAlgebra k (Fin (n + 2) → G) := fun n c => ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), MonoidAlgebra.single (Fin.insertNth j.castSucc (u (c j)) (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => if i < j then u (c i) else v (c i))) ((-1 : k) ^ j.val); let C := ((Rep.resFunctor H.subtype).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj (Rep.standardComplex k G); ∃ D : ∀ n : ℕ, C.X n ⟶ C.X (n + 1), ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → G), (D n).hom (MonoidAlgebra.single c (1 : k)) = P n c
theorems.natural_summary: Extends the signed prism assignment linearly and establishes subgroup equivariance on generators, yielding the required representation morphisms.
